summary: chore(content-server): remove Backbone email-first and index views
description:
Because:

- React serves /, /oauth and /authorization, so the Backbone index views and their mixins are dead code.
- The emailFirstRoutes and simpleRoutes flags are always on.

This commit:

- Routes (/), authorization(/) and oauth(/) to React and keeps the oauth query.
- Deletes the index, authorization and ready views, 11 mixins and their specs.
- Removes the emailFirstRoutes, simpleRoutes and showReactApp config.
- Keeps the Mobile Safari verification exception in app-start.js.

Closes FXA-14378
